Test Fixture                                                      vector
Request for Comments: 99998                               Not an RFC
Category: Informational                                  November 2026


              Emit Panics: Every Clause Kind and Type

Abstract

   This text is a test fixture for the Nish tests vector emits, laid
   out as an RFC's plain text so that vector reads it.  It is not an
   RFC.

1.  Stubs

   Each stub function MUST return what it is given.

   The bytes stubs are run on these values:

      Bytes = 00ff10
      Long = 000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f1011121314151617
      Pair = c0de
      One = 7f
      Key = a1b2

   with Long's result truncated to 128 bits, and Pair's run 3 times
   and 1,000 times.  The string stubs are run on "abc", on "xyz" and
   on "" (0 octets), the window stubs on "sum" and on "hello".

   The words stubs are run on these 16-bit words:

      a = 0x0001
      b = 0xffff

   on these 32-bit words:

      c = 0x00000001
      d = 0xffffffff

   and on these 64-bit words:

      e = 0x0000000000000001
      f = 0xffffffffffffffff

   and they return these 16-bit words:

      g = 0xffff
      h = 0x0001

   these 32-bit words:

      i = 0xffffffff
      j = 0x00000001

   and these 64-bit words:

      k = 0xffffffffffffffff
      l = 0x0000000000000001
